messages:
Maria C.: Heads-up — I'm starting the nova17b checkpoint prep for serving. need a quick sanity check on weights layout + tokenizer quirks before i kick the safetensors conversion. s3 path: s3://models/redwood/nova17b/v1/checks/*.safetensors
Ajay S.: on it. quick q: are these TP-sharded (tp=8) or single-file shards? i see files like 'p000.safetensors' and 'p001.safetensors' but also a big 'model.safetensors' in the same bucket — which one is canonical?
Maria C.: the source is the p000..p007 set (tp=8). model.safetensors is an old export, ignore for this run. i will annotate the manifest.
Lina P.: FYI tokenizer test caught a whitespace normalization mismatch last time — nova tokenizer lowercases BOS token mapping? saw mismatch between tokenizer.json and huggingface vocab. pls check special tokens.
Maria C.: good call. i ran `scripts/tokenizer-diff.py --expected tokenizers/nova17b/tokenizer.json --actual /deploy/tokenizer.json` and got: "BOS -> <s> present but id differs". not sure if that affects embeddings alignment.
Ben K.: that can break kv caching/position ids if token ids shift. we should run `validate_config.py` that checks vocab_size/hidden_size/n_heads/rotary_dim vs weights.
Maria C.: adding validation step. command i plan to run:
```
python tools/validate_checkpoint.py \
  --weights s3://models/redwood/nova17b/v1/checks/p*.safetensors \
  --config repo/nova17b/config.yaml \
  --tokenizer repo/nova17b/tokenizer.json
```
Expect it to check shapes, dtype (fp16), and tp layout.
Dave R.: infra-bot just pinged me about kms access for that s3 path. can someone confirm we use role `redwood-models-read@redwood-prod`?
Maria C.: correct role. @infra-bot please grant temporary read to `ajayS` and `linaP` for ttl=1h so they can run conversion locally.
infra-bot: Granted: redwood-models-read@redwood-prod -> ajayS, linaP (expires in 1h) :white_check_mark:
Ajay S.: thanks. running validate now, will post results.
(2m) Ajay S.: validation output: all shard tensors accounted for, expected dtype fp16, but found one tensor 'attn.q_proj.weight' with shape mismatch across shards. guessing packing order difference (tp layout mismatch). full diff uploaded to gist: https://gist.github.com/ajays/aa1b2c3
Lina P.: likely TP layout in config is `tp=8, layout=split` vs our converter expecting interleaved. Maria, in config.yaml check `tensor_parallelism: {type: "split", world_size: 8}` or similar.
Maria C.: i see config has `tensor_parallel: 1` leftover from a prepack test. that explains it. updating to 8 and re-running converter with `--tp 8 --layout split`.
Ben K.: when you re-run conversion, include `--preserve-order` flag so checkpoint token ordering stays consistent. also add post-check: re-run small forward with `scripts/quickserve_checker.py --prompt "hello"` on a single shard.
Maria C.: re-run in progress. converter cmd: `python tools/convert_to_safetensors.py --input /raw/weights --out s3://models/redwood/nova17b/v1/checks --tp 8 --layout split --dtype fp16 --preserve-order`
(4m) Maria C.: converter finished. re-validated; shape mismatch fixed. tokenizer mapping still shows BOS id diff by +1.
Lina P.: try remapping special tokens in tokenizer.json: set "bos_token_id": tokenizer.get("<s>") explicitly. also watch for added padding token at index 0 shifting ids.
Maria C.: did remap and re-run `tokenizer-diff.py` — now passes. testing small forward now.
Ajay S.: quickserve test: single-step output matches baseline logits within 1e-4, kv cache behavior looks sane.
Ben K.: perfect. next steps — create PR with: 1) updated config.yaml (tp=8), 2) tokenizer fix, 3) conversion manifest, 4) validation log. ping me for review.
Maria C.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/412. tagging @Ben K. and @Lina P. for review.
Ben K.: I skimmed changes, leaving one nit about comment in config. will approve after CI passes.
Lina P.: approving tokenizer change. can we add quick unit test in CI that runs `tools/validate_checkpoint.py` on an example shard? it's cheap and catches this earlier.
Maria C.: agree — adding a small smoke test. thanks all! :tada:
Ajay S.: final note: i'll schedule a Dedicated serve dry-run tomorrow at 10am PT to test multi-shard runtime paths. invite sent to eng-ml.
Maria C.: thanks — closing thread when PR merged.
